KernelInspection is signature support, but every nested field is client-visible. Keep owner/ref identities, counts, source/execution modes, frame stages and waits; change order/phase/position/config and pending request vocabulary, and remove legacy group.
CTTAbstractParent is only reachable through deprecated content. Remove this $d/$c support shape with legacy vertex forms.
MutableRef truthfully names mutable indirection, and getValue/setValue/getRefId separate value from reference identity. Remove ambiguous getId forwarding alias; constructor value is caller-owned.

VisitOrder is a private supporting union of callback phases; literals PRE/IN/POST/LEVEL_ORDER and ON_WORK_READY/ON_SUBGRAPH_READY are meaningful, but rename support vocabulary to TreeDagVisitorPhase when diagnostics stop saying order.

OwnerToken is an observational request-owner token; kind root/frame/chain/prerequisite, numeric id and epoch are scoped to engine work ownership and not caller IDs. Retain this diagnostic support shape.

CallbackValues is engine payload typing, not independent API. Its keys become public through pendingRequests.kind; decouple them into descriptive public operation labels instead of leaking MAKE_ROOT/MAKE_VERTEX/HINT_ID.
DagDiscoveryCycleError and vertexIds identify structural discovery cycle participants; ID generic preserves arbitrary identity and inherited Error semantics remain standard.

DagTraversalStallDiagnostics distinguishes unmet prerequisites, unknown IDs, SCC components, original wait edges, dependency-blocked IDs and structurally incomplete IDs. dependencies.id/unmet are scoped ID projections; edges retain W/C precision. No renaming of direction is needed.
DagMilestone combines vertexId with work/subgraphCompletion; the pair is necessary because C includes W plus structural descendants. These are milestone targets, not events.
DiagnosticId prevents inference widening when constructing an error; the conditional tuple is signature machinery, not a caller-visible identity normalization.
DagTraversalStallError carries diagnostic evidence and standard Error fields. Constructor permits omitted dependencyEdges for handwritten diagnostics; engine-produced diagnostics remain richer.
DagWaitEdge waiter/prerequisite make direction explicit; reasons distinguish declared W/C waits from ownWork and structuralChild constraints. Keep this vocabulary.
ExecutionInspection is the genuine cross-family minimum; status/stopReason/pauseRequested, execution and counts are passive observations and kind is extensible.
VertexRef is the deliberate MutableRef<Vertex<T>> specialization; it denotes reference identity, not a host ID. Both generic and domain alias serve distinct roles.
VisitResult adds void/undefined to phase-gated traversal command results; the private alias avoids repeating support algebra.
HintVertexId wraps an ID so undefined can mean a valid own vertexId rather than absence of an identity result; getVertexIdFromHint is not vertex resolution.

ResolvedVertexStatus combines initial-visit and completion scheduling stages across DFS/BFS/DAG, so PRE_VISITING/PRE_VISITED are false family cues and not DagWorkState. Rename to ResolvedVisitStage with explicit initial/completion stage literals.
StructuralChildEdge parentRef/childRef/hintIndex/hint describes one structural slot, independently from dependency constraints. Index is in discovery hint order.

ChildSlot is a live resolution-slot union: pending/linked/omitted/deleted/disabled distinguish undiscovered, resolved and terminal absence. Own optional vertexId on omission preserves undefined IDs. Keep the hint and linked childRef roles.

ResolvedGraphVertex is a detached record describing a live reference, payload, discovery depth, original dependencies, incoming structural edges and slots. Retain these names; replace status with visitStage to avoid conflating graph visit stages and DAG work state.
VisitorRecord is the shared list/set record support type: visitor callback, addedIndex and group provenance are useful; remove LegacyVisitorOptions resolutionStyle from it.
VertexId = unknown intentionally makes no string/serialization assumption. It is a domain alias, not a runtime validator or brand.
MaybePromise<T> is conventional value-or-PromiseLike support across async APIs; accepting sync implementations is deliberate.
MutationCommandBuilder builds one mutation command from a typed rewrite request; output payload and RewriteInput are independently configurable, so the generic name is earned.

OriginalGraphView is a retained live structural view with shallow shared data and distinct retained refs; keep role/name and queries, but remove getVertexById/getIdOf aliases.

ResolvedTreeTypeParameters still uses the old TypeParameters vocabulary; use ResolvedTreeVertexTypes to match VertexTypes. Its VertexData and VertexHint both contain refs intentionally.
ResolvedTreeView is a live query capability with shallow detached arrays/contexts; getRoot/has/parent/children/path/context are unambiguous on this receiver. It does not claim deep immutability.
